But those who believed and did not emigrate - for you there is no support of them until they emigrate. And if they seek help of you for the religion, then you must help, except against a people between yourselves and whom is a treaty. And Allāh is Seeing of what you do.
ayahs.transliteration: Innal latheena aamanoo Wa-haajaroo Wa-jaahadoo bi-amwaalihim Wa-anfusihim fee sabeelil laahi wallatheena aawaw Wa-nasarooo ulaaa'ika ba'duhum awliyaaa'u ba'd; wallatheena aamanoo Wa-lam yuhaajiroo maa lakum minw walaayatihim min shai'in hatta yuhaajiroo; Wa-inis tansarookum fid deeni fa'alaiku munnasru illaa 'alaa qawmin bainakum Wa-bainahum meesaaq; wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona Baseer
ayahs.translationClear: Those who believed, and emigrated, and struggled in Allah’s cause with their possessions and their persons, and those who provided shelter and support—these are allies of one another. As for those who believed, but did not emigrate, you owe them no protection, until they have emigrated. But if they ask you for help in religion, you must come to their aid, except against a people with whom you have a treaty. Allah is Seeing of what you do.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ إِلَّا تَفْعَلُوهُ تَكُن فِتْنَةٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌ كَبِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ‌ۚ إِلَّا تَفْعَلُوهُ تَكُن فِتْنَةٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌ كَبِيرٌ ٧٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بَعۡضُهُمۡ اَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٍ​ؕ اِلَّا تَفۡعَلُوۡهُ تَكُنۡ فِتۡنَةٌ فِى الۡاَرۡضِ وَفَسَادٌ كَبِيۡرٌؕ‏
ayahs.translation: And those who disbelieved are allies of one another. If you do not do so [i.e., ally yourselves with other believers], there will be fitnah [i.e., disbelief and oppression] on earth and great corruption.
ayahs.transliteration: Wallatheena kafaroo ba'duhum awliyaaa'u ba'd; illaa taf'aloohu takun fitnatun fil ardi Wa-fasaadun kabeer
ayahs.translationClear: As for those who disbelieve, they are allies of one another. Unless you do this, there will be turmoil in the land, and much corruption.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاوَوا۟ وَّنَصَرُوٓا۟ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا ۚ لَّهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَهَاجَرُواْ وَجَـٰهَدُواْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاوَواْ وَّنَصَرُوٓاْ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا‌ۚ لَّهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ ٧٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَهَاجَرُوۡا وَجٰهَدُوۡا فِىۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اَاوَوْا وَّنَصَرُوۡۤا اُولٰۤٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ حَقًّا​ ؕ لَّهُمۡ مَّغۡفِرَةٌ وَّرِزۡقٌ كَرِيۡمٌ‏
ayahs.translation: But those who have believed and emigrated and fought in the cause of Allāh and those who gave shelter and aided - it is they who are the believers, truly. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.
ayahs.transliteration: Wallatheena aamanoo Wa-haajaroo Wa-jaahadoo fee sabeelil laahi wallatheena aawaw Wa-nasarooo ulaaa'ika humul mu'minoona haqqaa; lahum maghfiratunw Wa-rizqun kareem
ayahs.translationClear: Those who believed, and emigrated, and struggled for Allah’s cause, and those who gave shelter and support—these are the true believers. They will have forgiveness, and a bountiful provision.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ مَعَكُمْ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍ فِى كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۢ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَهَاجَرُواْ وَجَـٰهَدُواْ مَعَكُمْ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ مِنكُمْ‌ۚ وَأُوْلُواْ ٱلْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍ فِى كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمُۢ ٧٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مِنۡۢ بَعۡدُ وَهَاجَرُوۡا وَجَاهَدُوۡا مَعَكُمۡ فَاُولٰۤٮِٕكَ مِنۡكُمۡ​ؕ وَاُولُوا الۡاَرۡحَامِ بَعۡضُهُمۡ اَوۡلٰى بِبَعۡضٍ فِىۡ كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ​ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِكُلِّ شَىۡءٍ عَلِيۡمٌ‏
ayahs.translation: And those who believed after [the initial emigration] and emigrated and fought with you - they are of you. But those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh.[459] Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of all things.
ayahs.transliteration: Wallatheena aamanoo min ba'du Wa-haajaroo Wa-jaahadoo ma'akum fa-Ulaaa'ika minkum; Wa-ulul arhaami baduhum awlaa biba'din fee Kitaabil laah; innal laaha bikulli shai'in 'Aleem

footnotes.459: This applies to Muslim relatives only. Others may be given by bequest. See 4:11.

ayahs.translationClear: As for those who believed afterwards, and emigrated and struggled with you—these belong with you. But family members are nearer to one another in the Book of Allah. Allah is Cognizant of everything.
